name: How long does it take to replace siding around a typical window?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace siding around a typical window?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration depends on the extent of the work, the type of siding, and whether any underlying damage needs repair. For a single window with no significant underlying issues, the replacement of surrounding siding can typically be completed within a few hours to half a day. If multiple windows are involved, or if rot and structural repairs are needed, the project could extend over several days. We provide a detailed timeline after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacing siding around a single window can take a few hours to half a day, but varies with project scope and any necessary repairs.
